# --description--

Converting to lower case is the usual way to compare text ignoring case: two strings that differ only in capitalization become equal once both are lowercased.

# --instructions--

Write a function `sameWord` that takes two `String` values (omit the argument labels) and returns `true` when they are equal ignoring case

# --before-seed--

```swift
// DO NOT EDIT FROM HERE
import Foundation

var _testCount = 0
var _testFailedCount = 0
func tryCatch(_ assertion: Bool) {
    _testCount += 1
    if !assertion {
        _testFailedCount += 1
        print("Test Case '--err-t\(_testCount)--' failed")
    }
}
// DO NOT EDIT UNTIL HERE
```

# --asserts--

`sameWord("Swift", "swift")` must return `true`

```swift
tryCatch(sameWord("Swift", "swift") == true)
```

`sameWord("HELLO", "hello")` must return `true`

```swift
tryCatch(sameWord("HELLO", "hello") == true)
```

`sameWord("Swift", "Swifty")` must return `false`

```swift
tryCatch(sameWord("Swift", "Swifty") == false)
```

`sameWord("", "")` must return `true`

```swift
tryCatch(sameWord("", "") == true)
```

# --after-asserts--

```swift
print("Executed \(_testCount) tests, with \(_testFailedCount) failures")
```

# --solutions--

```swift
func sameWord(_ a: String, _ b: String) -> Bool {
    return a.lowercased() == b.lowercased()
}
```
